en: The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of the ruins of an old church, with a small structure (likely a gate or entrance) in the foreground, partial stone walls of the ruined church, a wooden fence, and trees. The background includes a rural landscape. The front contains printed and handwritten text in Swedish. The back features Swedish handwriting, a green Swedish postage stamp, and traditional postcard formatting.
